Dear [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744)
I think you must have heard from [Mrs Lennard](../persons.html#121) by this time, as she mentioned, in a letter I had yesterday, having heard from you. I was out all day and could not write.
[Miss Hugessen](../persons.html#820) is ill and cannot do her paper this month but there are to be retrospective questions. I think the same notice will do. I will write the notices but I think I shall have to ask for an additional sheet as so much has to be finished
A lady complains of a book by [the author](../persons.html#1467) of Robert Elsmere being there advertised on [the Packet](../others.html#52) I mean.

Yours truly

C M Yonge
